title: Crop Decision Command Centre & Agronomic Planning

methods.name: Field-aware evidence reuse
methods.implementation: Persisted Field/Twin weather and decision evidence are preferred before a new external retrieval is requested.
methods.boundary: Reusing evidence does not imply that gridded weather is a local station measurement.

methods.name: Historical sowing-date climate exposure
methods.implementation: Candidate sowing dates are compared across historical daily weather using explicit heat, water-balance, dry-spell and GDD summaries.
methods.boundary: Not an official crop calendar, mechanistic cultivar yield simulation or causal treatment recommendation.

methods.name: Versioned crop/cultivar profiles
methods.implementation: Independent SQLite registry with parent profile identity plus immutable parameter-version history, author, region, evidence grade and citation.
methods.boundary: Researcher profiles do not overwrite validated source profiles or automatically become global defaults.

methods.name: Operational pest-risk inference
methods.implementation: Only Research Model Registry artifacts explicitly marked Operationally eligible can be used from the main Crop Decisions operational pathway; model inputs and applicability are checked.
methods.boundary: Risk prediction is not pest confirmation, disease diagnosis or pesticide instruction.

methods.name: Nutrient optimisation readiness
methods.implementation: Checks structured samples, nutrient operations, rate variation and observed outcomes before promoting nutrient-response optimisation.
methods.boundary: Readiness indicators do not prove identifiability or causal nutrient response.

methods.name: Yield evidence disagreement
methods.implementation: Registered model predictions and observed outcomes are compared without silently averaging predictions from heterogeneous model families.
methods.boundary: Model disagreement requires validation/applicability review rather than selection by convenience.

methods.name: Field-aware AquaCrop / DSSAT / APSIM evidence
methods.implementation: Active field/season and persisted canonical weather can populate model workflows; run status and configuration provenance can be preserved.
methods.boundary: A successful executable run is not evidence that cultivar, soil, nitrogen or management parameterisation is calibrated or equivalent across backends.

methods.name: Recommendation → Action → Outcome
methods.implementation: Crop Decisions exposes the existing decision ledger so proposed recommendations remain distinct from actual action and measured outcome.
methods.boundary: Recommendation acceptance/application is not proof of agronomic benefit or causality.
